summary: Generative AI image and video studio with a CLI, MCP server and a REST generation API.
access_note: API is a standalone product billed on its own balance via console.higgsfield.ai; the MCP/CLI use browser sign-in and spend plan credits on a paid Higgsfield plan.
blocker_note: Generation consumes paid credits or API balance; no confirmed free tier for API.

evidence.quote: API credentials grant access to your account and its balance.
Do not call the API directly from browser or mobile application code.
Run Higgsfield from the command line in Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible CLI agent.
No API keys to manage or configure.

notes: Docs use Authorization: Key ID:SECRET. Paid-subscription and separate-billing claims come from search snippets, not fetched pages. MCP URL from higgsfield.ai/mcp. Credential header and base URL https://api.higgsfield.ai from docs.
